title.english: A Date Is Not a Reason

pairs.target: tiān méi liàng , tǎ wéi bèi yuànzi lǐ de mùlún shēng jīngxǐng , yòushǒu yǐjīng zhuāzhù le chuángyán .
pairs.english: Before dawn, Tavi was startled awake by the sound of wooden wheels in the courtyard, his right hand already gripping the bed’s edge.
pairs.hanzi: 天没亮，塔维被院子里的木轮声惊醒，右手已经抓住了床沿。

pairs.target: tā rènchū nà shì sòng shuǐ de chē , cái sōngkāi , zhǎngxīn yízhèn tiào tòng , gébì huò chéng zài jiào rén , xiǎng fānshēn què bùgǎn zìjǐ fān .
pairs.english: He recognised the water cart and only then let go, his palm in a spell of throbbing pain; next door Huo Cheng was calling for someone, wanting to turn over but afraid to do it himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他认出那是送水的车，才松开，掌心一阵跳痛，隔壁霍成在叫人，想翻身却不敢自己翻。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi guòqù tì tā fúzhù shuǐ wǎn , yòng de shì zuǒshǒu , liǎnggè rén huā le hěn jiǔ cái ràng wǎn yán pèngdào tā de zuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi went over to hold the water bowl for him, using his left hand; it took the two of them a long time for the rim to touch his mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维过去替他扶住水碗，用的是左手，两个人花了很久才让碗沿碰到他的嘴。

pairs.target: huò chéng hēwán , shuō zìjǐ cóngqián zǒng xián qīzǐ gěi fàn bāo duō dǎ yìcéng jié , xiànzài dǎo xiǎng yǒurén zài gěi tā dǎ yícì .
pairs.english: When Huo Cheng finished drinking, he said he used to complain about his wife adding another knot to his meal bundle, but now he wished someone would tie one for him again.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成喝完，说自己从前总嫌妻子给饭包多打一层结，现在倒想有人再给他打一次。

pairs.target: tiānliàng hòu , zhàn lǐ qǐnglái de yīzhě chóngxīn kàn le tuǐ , shuō shāng de zhòng , děi sòng jìnchéng lǐ , zhīhòu néng huīfù duōshǎo , yǎnxià bùnéng gěi zhǔnhuà .
pairs.english: After daybreak, the practitioner called by the station examined the leg again and said it was badly injured and needed treatment in the city; for now, how much it would recover was impossible to say for certain.
pairs.hanzi: 天亮后，站里请来的医者重新看了腿，说伤得重，得送进城里，之后能恢复多少，眼下不能给准话。

pairs.target: huò chéng méiyǒu zài wèn shénme shíhòu néng káng mùliào , zhī wèn jìnchéng de chē yào duōshǎo qián , qīzǐ lái de lùfèi yòu yào duōshǎo .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng did not ask again when he could carry timber, only asked what the city cart would cost, and what his wife’s travel expenses would be too.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成没有再问什么时候能扛木料，只问进城的车要多少钱，妻子来的路费又要多少。

pairs.target: nài lěi qǐng zhàn lǐ xiān bǎ yùn rén de chē dìngxià , fèiyòng jì zài tā míngxià , huò chéng jiālǐ de xìn yě gēnzhe zǒu , sòngdào jiā zhīqián réngjiù bùnéng suàn rén yǐ zhīdào .
pairs.english: Nerai asked the station first to book a cart to transport the injured, charging the cost to her; the letter for Huo Cheng’s household would go along too, though until it reached home they still could not count his family informed.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾请站里先把运人的车订下，费用记在她名下，霍成家里的信也跟着走，送到家之前仍旧不能算人已知道。

alignment.english: a cart to transport the injured

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tì huò chéng dāying jiālǐ de shì , wèn guò tā yǐhòu , cái qǐng sòngxìnrén gàosù tā qīzǐ , dào chénglǐ nǎjiā yīguǎn zhǎo .
pairs.english: She made no decisions about Huo Cheng’s household for him; only after asking him did she request that the messenger tell his wife which clinic in the city to find him at.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有替霍成答应家里的事，问过他以后，才请送信人告诉他妻子，到城里哪家医馆找。

pairs.target: zǎofàn shí tā yòng yòushǒu bāi bǐng , bāi le liǎngcì dōu méiyǒu bāikāi , tǎ wéi shēnshǒu , tā bǎ bǐng tuī gěi tā , què méiyǒu zài shì zuǒshǒu .
pairs.english: At breakfast she tried to break the flatbread with her right hand, twice without success; Tavi reached over, and she pushed the bread to him, but did not try her left hand again.
pairs.hanzi: 早饭时她用右手掰饼，掰了两次都没有掰开，塔维伸手，她把饼推给他，却没有再试左手。

pairs.target: tā dīzhetóu fēnchéng xiǎo kuài , hūrán wèn , zuótiān tā shìbushì yě pà .
pairs.english: He divided it into little pieces with his head lowered, then suddenly asked whether she had been afraid yesterday too.
pairs.hanzi: 他低着头分成小块，忽然问，昨天她是不是也怕。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le tā yíhuìer , shuō pà , dìèrgēn shǐ chūlái shí , tā méiyǒu bǎwò néngdài tā zǒuchū nà kuài zhēdǎng .
pairs.english: Nerai looked at him for a while and said she had been afraid: as the second bolt came, she had not been sure she could get him beyond that cover.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看了他一会儿，说怕，第二根矢出来时，她没有把握能带他走出那块遮挡。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ hái xiàqù . "
pairs.english: “And you still went down.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你还下去。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōwán , cái zhīdào zìjǐ búshì zài wèn tā wèishénme .
pairs.english: Only after Tavi said it did he realise he was not asking her why.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说完，才知道自己不是在问她为什么。

pairs.target: " tā zài xiàmiàn , " tā shuō , " érqiě wǒ yǒu shéng , yǒu néng luòjiǎo de dìfāng . "
pairs.english: “He was below,” she said, “and I had rope and had somewhere to put my feet.”
pairs.hanzi: “他在下面，”她说，“而且我有绳，有能落脚的地方。”

pairs.target: tā tíng le yíhuìer , gàosù tā , méi shì guò gōu , yě zhǎo búdào luòjiǎochù , tā xiàqù jiù zhǐshì zài diào yígè rén .
pairs.english: She paused for a while and told him that without testing the hook or finding footing, going down would only mean one more person falling.
pairs.hanzi: 她停了一会儿，告诉他，没试过钩，也找不到落脚处，她下去就只是再掉一个人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ xiá lǐ nà liǎngpiàn tiě , wèn tā wèishénme bù bǎ zhěngkuài lù bǎn biànde jiēshi yìdiǎn , nǎpà zhǐ chēng yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of the two iron strips in the case and asked her why she had not made the whole road board sturdier, even if only to hold for a little while.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起匣里那两片铁，问她为什么不把整块路板变得结实一点，哪怕只撑一会儿。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu ná tā de kèyè xiào tā , wèn tā , zìjǐ pèng guò nà kuàibǎn méiyǒu , zhīdào lǐmiàn làn dào le nǎér méiyǒu , yòu zhǔnbèi ràng nǎ yì zhěngjiàn dōngxī gēnzhe gǎibiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai did not mock his schoolwork, but asked whether she had touched that board, whether she knew how far the rot went inside, and which other whole object she was ready to change along with it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有拿他的课业笑他，问他，自己碰过那块板没有，知道里面烂到了哪儿没有，又准备让哪一整件东西跟着改变。

pairs.target: tā wàng zhe zhuō yán , xiǎngqǐ nà piàn mùcáo lǐ gèng nán wān de tiě , yě xiǎngqǐ duànkǒu xiàmiàn yǐjīng kōng le de dìfāng , méiyǒu zài wǎng xià shuō .
pairs.english: He looked at the table’s edge, remembering the iron in the wooden channel that had become harder to bend, also recalling the empty space now below the break; he said no more.
pairs.hanzi: 他望着桌沿，想起那片木槽里更难弯的铁，也想起断口下面已经空了的地方，没有再往下说。

pairs.target: tā gàosù tā , biànde bù róngyì wān , búshì duàndiào de dōngxī huì chóngxīn jiēshàng , gèng búshì tā gé zhe jǐgè rén jiù néng pèngdào tā .
pairs.english: She told him that becoming harder to bend did not mean a broken object would join itself back together, still less that she could touch it through several people.
pairs.hanzi: 她告诉他，变得不容易弯，不是断掉的东西会重新接上，更不是她隔着几个人就能碰到它。

pairs.target: yuàn wài yǒurén zhēng qǐlái , shuō duànkǒu yǐjīng yòng shéng lánzhù , xiān ràng qīngchē guò , shānmén lái de lù huì dàibiǎo hái méi zuòxià , jiù bèi yú mào lā qù kàn tā de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: An argument broke out outside: the break had been roped off, someone said, so let light carts pass first; the road association delegate from the mountain gate had not even sat down before Yu Mao pulled him over to see his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 院外有人争起来，说断口已经用绳拦住，先让轻车过，山门来的路会代表还没坐下，就被余茂拉去看他的袖子。

pairs.target: tā de xiù shàng hái zhān zhe huò chéng de xuè , xiànzài gān le , tā bǎ nà zhī gēbo jǔ de hěn gāo , wèn tāmen , qīngchē dǎng bu dǎngdezhù nǔ .
pairs.english: His sleeve still bore Huo Cheng’s blood, dry now; he raised that arm high and asked them whether a light cart could stop a crossbow.
pairs.hanzi: 他的袖上还沾着霍成的血，现在干了，他把那只胳膊举得很高，问他们，轻车挡不挡得住弩。

pairs.target: nài lěi zǒu dào ménbiān , lánzhù le yào dài rén qù jiǎn chē de zhàn lǐ huǒjì , ràng tā xiān wènqīng qiánmiàn de lù yǒuméiyǒu chá guò .
pairs.english: Nerai went to the door and stopped the station worker about to take people to retrieve the cart, telling him first to find out whether the road ahead had been checked.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾走到门边，拦住了要带人去捡车的站里伙计，让他先问清前面的路有没有查过。

pairs.target: huǒjì shuō zhǐshì qù zhǎo duàn bǎn dǐxià nàliàngchē , búhuì zhuī rén , shuōwán kànjiàn tā chuí zài shēn qián de zuǒbì , shēngyīn dī le xiàqù .
pairs.english: The worker said they were only going to find the cart below the broken boards, not chase anyone; then he saw her left arm hanging in front of her and his voice grew quieter.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计说只是去找断板底下那辆车，不会追人，说完看见她垂在身前的左臂，声音低了下去。

pairs.target: tā shuō búshì bùgāi zhǎo , érshì xiànzài bùnéng bǎ liǎngjiànshì dàngchéng yíjiàn , yú mào de chē yào zhǎo , ná nǔ de rén yě hái méiyǒu zhǎodào .
pairs.english: She said it was right to look, but the two things could not be treated as one now: Yu Mao’s cart needed finding, and the person with the crossbow had not been found either.
pairs.hanzi: 她说不是不该找，而是现在不能把两件事当成一件，余茂的车要找，拿弩的人也还没有找到。

pairs.target: lù huì de rén zhōngyú bǎ yǐzi fàngxià , zhàn lǐ lìng zhǎo liǎnggè rén shǒuzhù jìnchù de lùkǒu , pài rén xiàng chénglǐ de xún lù chù bàoxìn , méiyǒu xuānbù lù yǐjīng ānquán .
pairs.english: The association people finally put down their chairs; the station found two more people to guard the nearby junction and sent someone to report to the city’s road patrol office, without declaring the road safe.
pairs.hanzi: 路会的人终于把椅子放下，站里另找两个人守住近处的路口，派人向城里的巡路处报信，没有宣布路已经安全。

pairs.target: dù yīng bǎ huò chéng de zhùchù yòu héduì yíbiàn , jiāng xìn jiāogěi le sòng tā jìnchéng nàliàngchē de gǎnchē rén , tǎ wéi kànzhe tāmen bǎ dānjià nuó dào chē páng , méi zài shàngqù bāng tái .
pairs.english: Du Ying checked Huo Cheng’s address once more and gave the letter to the driver taking him into the city; Tavi watched them moving the stretcher beside the cart and did not go over to help lift it again.
pairs.hanzi: 杜缨把霍成的住处又核对一遍，将信交给了送他进城那辆车的赶车人，塔维看着他们把担架挪到车旁，没再上去帮抬。

pairs.target: huò chéng gé zhe dānjià biān shēnchū yìzhī shǒu , tǎ wéi biàn zǒujìn , bǎ zìjǐ de zuǒshǒu dìguòqù , ràng tā wò le yíxià .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng reached a hand over the stretcher’s side; Tavi came closer and offered his own left hand for him to hold for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成隔着担架边伸出一只手，塔维便走近，把自己的左手递过去，让他握了一下。

pairs.target: wǎng chì píng de chuánhuà yě zhōngyú yǒu le zhuóluò , yíliàng nánxià de tàn chē kěn dài xìn dào mǎtóu , nài lěi xiěmíng bùnéng àn yuándìng shíjiān gǎnshàng zhuāng yán , hòuxù yào děng shāngshì hé dàolù xiāoxī zàiyì .
pairs.english: Word to Red Flats finally had a way forward too: a southbound charcoal cart would carry a letter to the quay, and Nerai wrote clearly that they could not make the scheduled salt loading; further plans must await word on the injuries and news of road conditions before being discussed again.
pairs.hanzi: 往赤坪的传话也终于有了着落，一辆南下的炭车肯带信到码头，奈蕾写明不能按原定时间赶上装盐，后续要等伤势和道路消息再议。

pairs.target: tā bǎ fēngkǒu yā hǎo jiāochūqù , méi shuō yán chuán yídìng huì děng , gèng méiyǒu bǎ zìjǐ xiěchéng míngzǎo hái néngdài rén gǎnlù de yàngzi .
pairs.english: She pressed the seal down and handed it over, without saying the salt boat was sure to wait, still less describing herself as able to lead anyone onward tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 她把封口压好交出去，没说盐船一定会等，更没有把自己写成明早还能带人赶路的样子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài tā shēnbiān , wèn tāmen shìbushì huí xuéyuàn , tā shuō shì , xiānhuíqù , gēn jìnchéng de chē zǒu , jīntiān búzài wǎng nán .
pairs.english: Tavi stood beside her and asked if they were going back to the academy; she said yes, back first, going with the carts into the city, no farther south today.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在她身边，问他们是不是回学院，她说是，先回去，跟进城的车走，今天不再往南。

pairs.target: huíchéng zǒu zuówǎn lái zhàn lǐ de lù , búbì jīngguò duànkǒu , zhàn lǐ ānpái liǎngliàngchē jiébàn , huò chéng xiān bèi tái shàng dìyīliàng , nài lěi hé tǎ wéi děng hòu yíliàng .
pairs.english: The return to the city used last night’s road to the station, avoiding the break; the station arranged for two carts to travel together, Huo Cheng was lifted first onto the leading cart while Nerai and Tavi waited for the second.
pairs.hanzi: 回城走昨晚来站里的路，不必经过断口，站里安排两辆车结伴，霍成先被抬上第一辆，奈蕾和塔维等后一辆。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng shuō kěxī , xiǎngdào huò chéng nàtiáo tuǐ , huà dào le zuǐbiān yòu yànxiàqù , nài lěi quèshuō kěxī yě kěyǐ shuō , búyòng wèile shòu le jīng jiù zhuāng chéng shénme dōu bù xiǎngyào .
pairs.english: He wanted to say it was a pity, but thinking of Huo Cheng’s leg, then swallowed the words on his lips; Nerai said he could call it a pity too, without pretending he wanted nothing just because he had been frightened.
pairs.hanzi: 他想说可惜，想到霍成那条腿，话到了嘴边又咽下去，奈蕾却说可惜也可以说，不用为了受了惊就装成什么都不想要。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái gàosù tā , zìjǐ hái xiǎng kàn chì píng de shuǐ , kàn liǎngàn méiyǒu shān dǎng zhe huì shì shénme yàngzi , shuōwán yòu juéde zhè yuànwàng zài cǐkè xiǎnde hěn qīng .
pairs.english: Only then he told her he still wanted to see the waters of Red Flats, to see what it would be like with no mountains blocking either bank; after saying it, he felt the wish seemed slight at that moment.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才告诉她，自己还想看赤坪的水，看两岸没有山挡着会是什么样子，说完又觉得这愿望在此刻显得很轻。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ tānkāi de jiù xíngchéng zhé hǎo , méi rēngjìn lú lǐ , shuō xiǎng qù de dìfāng réngrán zài nàlǐ , kě tāmen bùnéng ná yǐjīng xiěxià de rìqī dàngzuò fēiqùbùkě de lǐyóu .
pairs.english: Nerai folded the old itinerary lying open, did not throw it in the stove, and said the places they wanted to visit were still there, but they could not use dates already written down as a reason they had to go.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把摊开的旧行程折好，没扔进炉里，说想去的地方仍然在那里，可他们不能拿已经写下的日期当作非去不可的理由。

pairs.target: yú mào zuò dào yuànzi lìngyìbiān , kànzhe kōng chūlái de chēwèi , dù yīng dūnxiàlái tóng tā shāngliáng jiè nǎ liàngchē huíqù , méiyǒu rén gàosù tā zhèdiǎn sǔnshī suàn zǒuyùn .
pairs.english: Yu Mao sat on the other side of the courtyard, looking at the empty cart space; Du Ying crouched to discuss which cart he could borrow to go home, and no one told him such a loss counted as good luck.
pairs.hanzi: 余茂坐到院子另一边，看着空出来的车位，杜缨蹲下来同他商量借哪辆车回去，没有人告诉他这点损失算走运。

alignment.english: the other side of the courtyard

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì nài lěi shōu hǎo pídài , shǒuzhǐ pèngdào nà kuài yǒu sāngè kèhén de bái pái , zhècì méiyǒu shǔ tā , fǎnér xiān qù kàn tā zhànwěn méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi packed away the leather bag for Nerai, his fingers touching the white tally with three notches; this time he did not count them, instead first looking to see whether she was steady on her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替奈蕾收好皮袋，手指碰到那块有三个刻痕的白牌，这次没有数它，反而先去看她站稳没有。

alignment.english: whether she was steady on her feet

pairs.target: yuànmén yòu xiǎng le , tā táiqǐ tóu , rènchū jìnchéng de chē , réng děng gǎnchē rén zǒujìn wèn le xìngmíng , cái hé nài lěi yìqǐ wǎng wài zǒu .
pairs.english: The courtyard gate sounded again; he raised his head and recognised the city-bound cart, but still waited for the driver to come closer and asked his name before walking out with Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 院门又响了，他抬起头，认出进城的车，仍等赶车人走近问了姓名，才和奈蕾一起往外走。
